Activate OneKuku inside this app (wireless debugging + ADB; Termux works without a PC):
1) Enable Wireless debugging in Developer options
2) Tap "Pair device with pairing code" and note the pair-port and code
3) In Termux (pkg install android-tools) run:
 adb pair localhost:pair-port code
4) Then: adb connect localhost:connect-port
5) Start channel:
 %1$s
6) Return to OneIMS and tap Activate OneKuku

Note: The channel is built into OneIMS — do not install a second privilege app from the store.
